entity.summary: Self-custodial Aptos wallet ecosystem developed by Aptos Labs and distributed across browser, mobile and web wallet surfaces.
entity.notes: Current Aptos Labs wallet terms explicitly describe Petra as self-custodial and state Aptos Labs never takes custody or control of user private keys. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current self-custodial Petra browser-extension wallet for Aptos accounts and applications.
products.notes: Selected extension boundary only; Petra mobile and Petra Web are deferred as separate runtimes. Initial extension launch date remains unresolved.

events.title: Petra Wallet 2.4.0 added perpetual trading
events.description: Petra Wallet version 2.4.0 was released on 2026-04-06 with perpetual trading for eligible users powered by Decibel, providing a dated lifecycle event for Petra.

events.title: Petra 2.0.0 delivered a redesigned wallet experience
events.description: Aptos Labs' Petra App Store version history records Petra 2.0.0 on 2025-07-29 with a refreshed design across mobile, extension, and web, smoother send/swap/staking flows, performance and navigation improvements, and improved support for multi-tabs, Earn, and liquid staking.

evidence.title: Petra Wallet Terms of Service
evidence.notes: Current Aptos Labs terms describe Petra wallet applications, browser extension and Petra Web as self-custodial and state Aptos Labs never takes custody or control of private keys.

evidence.title: Aptos Labs Products — Petra Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party product page identifies Petra as self-custodial and states only the user can access wallet keys.

evidence.title: Petra Wallet Terms of Use
evidence.notes: First-party Petra terms explicitly cover the Petra wallet application and browser extension. This evidence confirms the official product boundary; current support-state promotion should remain conservative unless paired with a current distribution surface.

evidence.title: Petra: Aptos Crypto Wallet - Version History
evidence.notes: App Store version history identifies Petra 2.4.0 on 2026-04-06 and its perpetual-trading feature release; candidate app_store_listing normalized to canonical database_reference.

evidence.title: Petra: Aptos Crypto Wallet — Version History
evidence.notes: Developer-maintained App Store version history records Petra 2.0.0 and its redesign across mobile, extension, and web.
